description: Preserve itemized payment history across the Active->Completed->Active lifecycle, add receipt view/add/edit/delete on Completed orders, and make permanent-delete clean up payments. Backend changes in api/index.js (production) MUST be mirrored in server/routes/orders.js. Requires one idempotent migration dropping the payments.order_id FK so payment rows can outlive their parent orders row. Frontend adds a Receipt button to the Completed tab and refreshes completed totals after a receipt change. This feature is self-contained; FEAT-002 (daily report) depends on the payment-preservation behavior added here but is implemented separately.
steps: Create d:/OMS PRESTAIR SYSTEMS LLP/oms-dashboard/api/payments-fk-migration.sql: an idempotent, manually-run migration (header comment like api/follow-up-type-migration.sql pointing at the Supabase SQL editor) containing `ALTER TABLE payments DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS payments_order_id_fkey;`. Rationale: payments.order_id REFERENCES orders(id) with NO ON DELETE clause (default NO ACTION) would block deleting the parent orders row while payment rows remain; dropping the FK lets payments outlive the orders row while keeping order_id as the link to deleted_orders.original_id.

In api/index.js `app.delete('/api/orders/:id')` AND server/routes/orders.js `router.delete('/:id')`: REMOVE the `supabase.from('payments').delete().eq('order_id', ...)` call so payments are preserved. After the deleted_orders archive insert succeeds, if the bumped `delId !== orders[0].id` (rare collision branch), run `supabase.from('payments').update({ order_id: delId }).eq('order_id', orders[0].id)` so payment rows follow the archived key that GET /api/orders/deleted/all exposes as id. Then delete the orders row as today. Keep cacheDel('orders','deleted_orders','payments_all').

In api/index.js payment endpoints POST `/api/orders/:id/payments`, PUT `/api/orders/:id/payments/:pid`, DELETE `/api/orders/:id/payments/:pid` AND their server/routes/orders.js mirrors (POST /:id/payments, PUT /:id/payments/:paymentId, DELETE /:id/payments/:paymentId): after mutating the payments row and computing received=SUM(payments.amount WHERE order_id=id), detect where the order lives. Query orders by id first; if a row exists, update received_amount/balance/percent_received there (current behavior). Else query deleted_orders by original_id=id; if found, read total from data.total_amount ?? data.totalAmount ?? 0, compute balance=total-received and percent = total ? parseFloat(((received/total)*100).toFixed(2)) : 0, and write back `data` (spread existing data, override the three fields) via supabase.from('deleted_orders').update({ data: newData }).eq('original_id', id). When the completed branch runs, also cacheDel('deleted_orders'). Keep the can_edit_receipt gate on PUT/DELETE and keep the order_edit_history RECEIPT_EDIT logging in PUT.

In api/index.js `app.post('/api/orders/deleted/:id/restore')` AND server/routes/orders.js `router.post('/deleted/:id/restore')`: after the new order inserts (newId = inserted[0].id), re-point payments with supabase.from('payments').update({ order_id: newId }).eq('order_id', parseInt(req.params.id)) (route id = original_id = archived key). Then recompute totals on the new order from its payments (received=SUM, total=inserted[0].total_amount, update received_amount/balance/percent_received on the orders row). Then delete the deleted_orders row as today. Keep adminOnly; cacheDel('orders','deleted_orders','payments_all').

In api/index.js `app.delete('/api/orders/deleted/:id')` AND server/routes/orders.js `router.delete('/deleted/:id')`: also delete preserved payments with supabase.from('payments').delete().eq('order_id', parseInt(req.params.id)) so nothing is orphaned. Keep adminOnly; add 'payments_all' to the cacheDel call in api/index.js.

In src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: add `const canEditReceipt = isAdmin || user.canEditReceipt` next to canEditCompleted (~line 203). Widen the completed Action <th> (~line 2185) and the Action <td> wrapper (~line 2240) conditions from (isAdmin || canEditCompleted) to (isAdmin || canEditCompleted || canEditReceipt). As the FIRST button inside that <td>, add {(isAdmin || canEditReceipt) && <button onClick={() => setShowPaymentForm(order)} style={{ ...styles.tblBtn, background: '#27ae60' }} title="Receipt">Receipt</button>}. Leave Edit (isAdmin||canEditCompleted), Restore (isAdmin), Permanent Delete (isAdmin) unchanged. PaymentForm needs no change (a completed order from /api/orders/deleted/all already carries id=original_id, orderNo, client, totalAmount).
In src/pages/Dashboard.jsx change handlePaymentSaved (~line 1059) to also refresh the completed list: () => { setShowPaymentForm(null); fetchOrders(); fetchDeletedOrders() }.
acceptance_criteria: api/payments-fk-migration.sql exists, is idempotent (DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS), and carries a manual-run header comment.
Neither api/index.js's move handler nor server/routes/orders.js's move handler deletes payment rows; both re-point payments to delId only in the collision-bump branch.

POST/PUT/DELETE payment handlers in BOTH backends update orders when an orders row exists, otherwise update the matching deleted_orders.data snapshot's received_amount/balance/percent_received recomputed from the payments table.

Restore in BOTH backends re-points payments to the new order id and recomputes totals before deleting the deleted_orders row; permanent-delete in BOTH backends deletes the payment rows for that order_id.

Dashboard.jsx shows a green Receipt button on completed rows for admins and canEditReceipt holders, the Action column renders for (isAdmin||canEditCompleted||canEditReceipt), and handlePaymentSaved refreshes both active and completed lists.

can_edit_receipt and can_edit_completed gates are intact; restore and permanent-delete remain admin-only. The Active->Completed->Active round trip in completed-payment-history-plan.md loses no payment data.

Run `npm run build` from oms-dashboard and confirm the Vite build completes with no errors (covers the Dashboard.jsx changes).
Code-review the move/restore/permanent-delete/payment-detection paths against the lossless round-trip walkthrough in .agents/tasks/completed-payment-history-plan.md.
findings:
Implemented and verified (node --check api/index.js = 0, node --check server/routes/orders.js = 0, npm run build succeeds; only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size warning, not an error).

For FEAT-002 (daily report) / integration:
- Migration constraint name: Postgres default FK name is `payments_order_id_fkey`. api/payments-fk-migration.sql runs `ALTER TABLE payments DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS payments_order_id_fkey;` (idempotent, manual one-time run in the Supabase SQL editor). MUST be run before the move endpoint can delete an orders row that still has payment rows.
- Completed-order payments are keyed by `payments.order_id = deleted_orders.original_id`. GET /api/orders/deleted/all exposes each completed order as id = original_id, so active payments key on orders.id and completed payments key on original_id. FEAT-002's byOrderId map: active rows use byOrderId[o.id], completed rows use byOrderId[d.original_id]. Pre-fix completed orders have NO payment rows and must fall back to the stored received number.
- Completed-order totals now live in deleted_orders.data as snake_case received_amount / balance / percent_received (recomputed from the payments table on every payment POST/PUT/DELETE). total is read as data.total_amount ?? data.totalAmount ?? 0.
- Collision-bump branch (delId !== orders[0].id) re-points payments to delId; normal branch leaves order_id = original id. Restore re-points payments to the new SERIAL id and recomputes totals. Permanent-delete now also deletes payment rows (no orphans).
- Dashboard: added `const canEditReceipt = isAdmin || user.canEditReceipt` (user.canEditReceipt already exists in the login response, backed by can_edit_receipt). Completed Action column now renders for (isAdmin || canEditCompleted || canEditReceipt); green Receipt button gated (isAdmin || canEditReceipt). handlePaymentSaved now also calls fetchDeletedOrders(). PaymentForm unchanged (uses order.id = original_id).
- can_edit_receipt gate kept on payment PUT/DELETE; RECEIPT_EDIT logging preserved in PUT. restore + permanent-delete remain adminOnly.
- NOTE: this change set does not touch portable-app/server/* mirrors (out of scope per the plan's relevant files; FEAT scope was api/index.js + server/routes/orders.js only).
